Manifest.Name: 投影仪展示区 / Projector Showcase
Manifest.Author: SaintCirno9
Manifest.Description:
为幻影投影仪加入展示区，默认 7×5 格（与初始展示柜大小相同），可在游戏“选项”中调整宽高。投影仪处于生效状态（与原版一致，电池有电）时，不论摆在店内哪里，其中存放的商品、招牌、许可证、黑灯与鉴定证书都视为在展示柜中，参与客源吸引、次日预测与展示柜检查；保留原版电池、改装模组与便签槽顺序，兼容已有存档。
Adds a showcase area to the Mirage Projector, defaulting to 7×5 cells (matching the starter display case) with configurable width and height in Options. Merchandise, signs, permits, black lamps and appraisal certificates stored inside the projector count as being in the display case for customer attraction, predictions and showcase checks while the projector is active (powered, same as vanilla), wherever you keep it in the store, while preserving vanilla battery, module and note slots and existing saves.
